name: Bash
prose: Combined stdout/stderr. Ten single-word deletion keywords and twelve phrases, matched case-insensitively as whole tokens, so `npm run del-lint` never trips `del`. Three patterns are special-cased because the shared one cannot express them: `git branch -D` case-sensitively so safe `-d` never fires, `git checkout -- <path>`, and `find … -delete`. `mv` counts only with force or a destination outside the workspace.
invariant: The deletion matcher fires on standalone destructive tokens and phrases without false-positiving on substrings, and a timeout kills the whole process tree.
